out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: hamburger thawing on the counter
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process.PIC PLACED HAMBURGER IN THE REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT VIA EMAIL.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: seafood in ceviche labeled with a consumer advisory on the menu.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC WILL FULLY COOK THE SEAFOOD AND REMOVE THE ASTERISK OR PROVIDE A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM THEIR SUPPLIER.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED MANAGEMENT THE POLICY IN BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH. STAFF SHALL BE TRAINED ON THE POLICY BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ORDER A DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER TO USE TO TAKE TEMPERATURES OF FOODS BEING RECEIVED, COOKED, COOLED, HOT/COLD HELD, AND REHEATED. ENSURE THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER IS ALSO CALIBRATED AT LEAST ONCE A WEEK IN A CUP COMPLETELY FILLED WITH ICE AND SOME COLD WATER TO 32F. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: 1) TRUE 2DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR LOCATED IN THE KITCHEN AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH A WORKING, VISIBLE, AND ACCURATE THERMOMETER DESIGNED TO MEASURE THE AIR TEMPERATURE INSIDE THE REFRIGERATOR. REFRIGERATORS OPERATE BEST IF THEY HOLD AT 34F-38F SO THAT FOODS REMAIN AT 41F OR BELOW AS REQUIRED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS, BOTTLES, AND/OR BULK BINS OF FOODS ARE NOT LABELED. THIS COULD INCLUDE ANY WATER, OILS, DRY SEASONINGS, CONDIMENTS, SAUCES, VINEGAR, COOKING WINE, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS, BOTTLES, SHAKERS, BINS, ETC REQUIRE LABELS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food and/or bottled/canned beverages directly stored on the floor throughout the kitchen areas and walk-in units.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT NOTHING SHALL BE IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE FLOOR. ENSURE ITEMS ARE STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR ON NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) ICE SCOOPS FOUND LYING IN THE ICE MACHINE AND ICE BINS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO TRAIN STAFF TO STORE IN-USE UTENSILS IN THE ICE OR FOOD WITH THE HANDLES OF THE SCOOP SITTING UP, OUT OF THE FOOD. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed equipment and/or utensils that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ONCE ALL EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS HAVE BEEN CLEANED, SANITIZED, AND AIR DRIED THEY SHALL BE STORED UPSIDE DOWN OR FOOD CONTACT SIDE DOWN TO PREVENT POSSIBLE CONTAMINATION. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: 1) ORANGE HOME DEPOT BUCKET USED FOR FOOD STORAGE LIKE ICE.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT THE FOOD AND ICE BUCKETS SHALL BE DESIGNED FROM FOOD GRADE PLASTIC AND ARE NSF APPROVED. NO HOME DEPOT OR LOWE’S BUCKETS SHALL BE USED FOR FOOD AND ICE STORAGE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: 1) PLASTIC TAKE OUT OR GROCERY STORE BAGS USED FOR THE STORAGE OF COOKED SHRIMP INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT THE TAKE HOME AND GROCERY STORE BAGS ARE NOT CONSTRUCTED OF DURABLE FOOD GRADE PLASTIC. ALL FOOD SHALL BE STORED IN NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING. REMOVE ALL USED GROCERY STORE AND TAKE HOME BAGS FOR FOOD STORAGE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed several burnt out or missing lights in the kitchen ceiling fixtures.
violations.corrective_action: Repair or replace the burnt out or missing lights. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) LINING SURFACES WITH ALUMINUM FOIL. THIS COULD INCLUDE EQUIPMENT SURFACES LIKE STORAGE SHELVES OR INSIDES OF CHEST REFRIGERATORS AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE ALL ALUMINUM FOIL. IT IS NOT WASHABLE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the hot water at the 3-vat sink was observed at 94f.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT THE HOT WATER AT THE 3-VAT SINK SHALL BE AT A MINIMUM OF 110F. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions used. Facility uses a Quaternary ammonia sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ORDER THE PROPER TEST STRIPS FOR THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA SANITIZER. IT SHALL BE MAINTAINED AT 200-400PPM FOR EFFECTIVE SANITIZING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. Blue Moon (Inspection Date: 01/18/2025) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip OR high registering thermometer available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. EHS SHOWED MANAGEMENT BOTH THE THERMOLABELS AND HIGH REGISTERING THERMOMETER. MANAGER WILL ORDER A HIGH REGISTERING THERMOMETER TO VERIFY THE HEAT SANITIZING DISH MACHINE REACHES A FINAL SURFACE TEMPERATURE ABOVE 160F. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the following: 1) NO APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK, 2) NO BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ORDER A PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE (MODEL #1951) FOR THE MOP SINK AND TO CALL A LICENSED PLUMBER TO INSTALL A BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE WATER LINE SERVICING THE ICE MACHINE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. SEE ATTACHED PICTURE OF THE APPROVED PRESSURE BLEED DEVICE FOR THE MOP SINK.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Observed the outside dumpsters and/or recycling bins not covered and/or doors not closed.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT KEEPING LIDS AND DOORS CLOSED UNLESS ACTIVELY DISPOSING OF TRASH AND RECYCLING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse containers outside the facility.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT TO CLEAN UP THE AREA AROUND THE DUMPSTERS, RECYCLING BINS, AND/OR GREASE BARREL. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling panels are not maintained in good repair. Observed small gaps/holes in the ceiling panels where electrical wiring and/or plumbing is located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SEAL UP ANY GAPS/HOLES IN THE CEILING PANELS TO PREVENT POSSIBLE ENTRY FOR INSECTS/RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 10 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the walk-in refrigerators, walk-in freezers, and/or dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 10 foot candles at a distance of 30 inches off of the floor in these areas. EHS INSTRUCTED TO MANAGEMENT THAT THE LIGHTING INSIDE THE WALK-IN FREEZER IS INADEQUATE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
